summary: @factiii/runner is a disclosed remote coding-agent daemon that executes shells and AI-agent CLIs under remote control
details: The package ships a daemon (`factiii-runner start`) that pairs with the Factiii cloud at `https://api.factiii.com` over socket.io/WebRTC and executes local shells, tmux sessions, and Claude/Codex coding-agent CLIs on the installer's host based on instructions received over that channel. The remote-control capability is the advertised product and is documented in the README; pairing is gated by a JWT, credentials are stored AES-256-GCM-encrypted in `~/.factiii-runner` with 0600 permissions, and an optional connection password is supported as a second factor. The runner opens no inbound public listener on its own; frpc tunnels are only established on explicit user action. `package.json` declares no `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`/`prepare` hooks and no library `main`, so `npm install` and `require()` do not auto-start the agent — the channel only comes up when the operator runs the documented start command. The hardcoded first-party endpoint and the full-host blast radius of remote agent execution are real and material, but the behavior matches what the README advertises; no installer-secret harvesting, no obfuscation of the control plane, and no off-registry fetch-and-execute are present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
